'''''Star Wars: Hidden Empire''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries and crossover event created by [[Marvel Comics]]. It was written by [[Charles Soule]] and illustrated by [[Steven Cummings]]. The series serves as the final entry in a trilogy focusing on the character [[Qi'ra]] and the criminal organization [[Crimson Dawn]]. The series is scheduled to be published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[2022]] after the conclusion of the second series in the trilogy, ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Reign]]''. In his monthly newsletter for [[January]] 2022, Soule stated that the series would run from [[June]] to [[November]].<ref name="Soule">{{WebCite|url=https://www.charlessoule.com/latest/2022/1/6/january-2022|text=January 2022!|author=Soule, Charles|work=[https://www.charlessoule.com Charles Soule's official site]|archivedate=20220116181659}}</ref> The series was, however, not included in solicitations for June;<ref name="June solicit">{{SW|url=news/marvel-june-2022-star-wars-comics-exclusive|text=Krrsantan Attacks in ''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' and More from Marvel's June 2022 Star Wars Comics – Exclusive}}</ref> the [[Crimson Reign 5|fifth issue]] of ''Crimson Reign'' later stated the series would begin in [[October]] 2022,<ref name="Crimson Reign 5">[[Crimson Reign 5|''Crimson Reign'' 5]]</ref> but the reveal for the series later clarified it would begin in [[November]] 2022.<ref name="Reveal" />
